transcript.answer: No, not any more. ADR-039 originally decided that review-type agents should be pinned to a different model family from the implementer. The settings UI would warn when both resolved to the same family. An amendment dated 2026-10-14 reversed this. `code-review` and `code-review-recheck` now run on `gemini-4-argon`, which is the same family as the implementation loop's `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`. `code-review-reply` stays on `claude-sonnet-4-6`. The amendment says cross-family review "is no longer a rule, only one input to the model choice." Its reason is a local bench on five merged pull requests with known must-fixes. Argon found all five that finished (one timed out) with no false alarms, against four of six for Sonnet. It also found a real bug that neither Sonnet nor the posted review caught (#2742). The cost is that Argon is about three times slower and about 40% dearer. The excerpt I read was cut off after "40% dearer", so there may be more detail I haven't seen.
